verdict.rationale: Relay's docs explicitly state invoicing lets 'Relay handle the follow-up' and supports recurring invoices and payment collection, suggesting some automated dunning/reminder capability for overdue invoices. However, there is no detail on how follow-up is configured (reminder cadence, overdue triggers) and no independent/community corroboration of this specific feature working well. Missing for 10: documented overdue-reminder configuration/settings, evidence of effectiveness, and third-party confirmation.
